title: Don't Let Him In
previousChoice: 1: Open the door (creator's creative decision, not an audience vote)

lines.text: Same glasses. Same jacket. Same smile. But the rain wouldn't touch him.
lines.sub: Same glasses. Same jacket. Same smile. But the rain wouldn't touch him.

lines.text: Nora, get away from him! That's not me!
lines.sub: “Nora, get away from him! That's not me!”

lines.text: He stepped forward, and stopped. As if the doorway were a wall.
lines.sub: He stepped forward… and stopped. As if the doorway were a wall.

lines.text: Go on, Theo. Tell her where you were three years ago. The night her dad disappeared.
lines.sub: “Go on, Theo. Tell her where you were three years ago. The night her dad disappeared.”

lines.text: I was at the tower that night. I saw your dad walk into the light. And then I saw him come out.
lines.sub: “I was at the tower that night. I saw your dad walk into the light… and then I saw HIM come out.”

lines.text: He wasn't the only one up there, Nora.
lines.sub: “He wasn't the only one up there, Nora.”

lines.text: The photo showed the tower, three years ago. Her father. Theo. And a girl in a yellow raincoat.
lines.sub: The photo showed the tower, three years ago. Her father. Theo. And a girl in a yellow raincoat.

lines.text: That's me. But I was never there.
lines.sub: “That's me… but I was never there.”
